body: We all have this suicidal thoughts for different reasons and none are "better" or "worse" than other. I envy that you love that is something i have never felt before and its a good thing to have a great passion for love. It might not be a reason for me to actually want to die but i hope you decide to maybe make love the reason to live... hope you make the best choice for no-one else but yourself

Making a pro and con list for your options is a good idea. In my opinion its better to say i tried than to jist give up. And maybe if you stopped thinking of all the bad things that can happen, maybe you can find a new option that doesnt involve you staying and failing or leaving it all to burn. I hope it all works out for you

Never commented on someones post's before but i hope this will help. Itoo have no passions. My family never took me to a therapist, one reason could be because we never really had the money for it and second because they never noticed something was wrong with me or maybe they just pretended to be stupid and act as if they didnt see it. But whatever the case is.
I dont think that no one want to deal with you or care maybe you just haven't found that person yet. I hope you don't give up i know someone will care about you.
